## ExecRequest.redact property

Whether to redact injected secret values from the captured `stdout` and `stderr` before they are returned. Defaults to `true`<!-- -->: every occurrence of an injected secret value in the captured output is replaced with `[REDACTED]`<!-- -->, so the raw secret never appears in [ExecResult](./vaultkeeper.execresult.md) even when the spawned command echoes it. Set to `false` to receive the raw, unredacted output — only for callers that genuinely need it (for example output that legitimately contains the secret and must be preserved), since doing so forfeits the redaction guarantee.

**Signature:**

```typescript
redact?: boolean | undefined;
```
